test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

When will the dress be returned?

options.text: When would you return the dress?
When shall you return the dress?
When will you return the dress?
When will you be returning the dress?

solution:
The correct answer is **"When will you return the dress?"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the passive voice, where the subject (**dress**) is receiving the action (**being returned**).
 
• To convert the sentence into active voice, we need to make the subject (whoever is responsible for returning the dress) the doer of the action.
 
• In this case, the subject is '**you**', so the correct active sentence would be 'When will you return the dress?'
 
• The sentence is in simple future tense, denoting a future action.
 
• The active voice makes the sentence more direct and clear.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 -** When would you return the dress? (incorrect) - This sentence is also in the active voice but uses the wrong auxiliary verb 'would', which implies a conditional action. The original sentence does not have any condition attached to it.
 
• **Option 2 - **When shall you return the dress? (incorrect) - This sentence is also in the active voice but uses the formal auxiliary verb 'shall', which is not commonly used in modern English. The correct auxiliary verb to use is 'will'.
 
• **Option 4 -** When will you be returning the dress? (incorrect) - This sentence is also in the active voice but uses the continuous form of the future tense, which implies an ongoing action. The original sentence does not indicate an ongoing action, but a single future action.
